name: io.github.swkstudios/unifi-fabric-mcp-server
description: MCP server for UniFi Fabric: Network, Protect, Site Manager, InnerSpace, Carrier Fabric, Mobility.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UniFi Site Manager API key (unifi.ui.com > API Keys).

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_WRITE_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Write control: allow (default) sends writes, dry-run previews every write without sending it, deny refuses every write.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_TOOL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Discovery meta-tools by default; full retains the complete catalog (recommended for gateways); codemode is experimental and read-only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The MCP_BEARER_TOKEN the server was started with.
